what: A dark cover over the screen (video behind) with a wide horizontal frame in the center, where logo pieces switch on one by one. After waiting 1.5s, at 1s intervals: corner triangle → three bars → corner circles (on for 1.2s). When all are on, the bars switch off, and 1s later the frame opens out to the screen edges over .9s as the corner pieces go to the screen corners and turn accent color, and the cover lifts over 1s. 1.9s later the whole cover fades over .7s and emits fx:done. Put a menu button where the pieces remain in the corners and the logo carries over into the button. Pressing it skips the remaining steps

options.first: Wait before the first piece (sec), default 1.5
options.[data-fx-part=shade]: Dark curtain (a video can be placed inside)
options.[data-fx-part=piece]: Logo pieces — lit in order. Corner pieces use data-key="tl"·"br"
options.fx:done: Event the curtain fires after fully clearing (the curtain is removed)

use: …
note: The original looks for a random point in the video before starting and waits for the first frame (up to 10s) — here it doesn’t wait
